title: The New Park Passport
clue: Somewhere nearby is a patch of green you have always meant to visit, and it has awards to give.
reveal: Visit a park you have never explored and hand out four awards chosen by your dog's own behavior. The visit ends with a hand-drawn passport stamp and a reading of the awards at the Best Rest spot.
objective: Explore a new park with your dog, give four awards based on what they do, and finish with a passport stamp for your collection.
instructions: Choose a park you have never visited, or never walked past the car park. Check its dog rules on the official site: leash laws, off-leash hours, seasonal bans and closed areas. Go at a quiet time.
Make a blank passport page: an index card or paper square with the park's name, four award lines and a circle in the corner for the stamp.
Arrive, leash on, and pause at the main gate for a minute. Let your dog sniff the entrance.

Wander a gentle loop and watch your dog for four awards: Best Sniff (where they linger longest), Best Look (where they stop to watch or prick their ears), Best Find (the thing they notice first, from a distance) and Best Rest (where they settle or slow down). Doodle each one on the card as it happens.
At the Best Rest spot, sit for five minutes with water. Read the four awards aloud to your dog, then let them watch the world or doze.
Draw your passport stamp in the circle: the park's initials, today's date and a tiny picture of the Best Sniff.
Keep the card with your other park pages, so next time you can choose a park by its awards.
twist: The four awards are won by your dog's own behavior, so the passport stamp records exactly what they chose: the best sniff, look, find and rest.
variations: Easier: a short flat park with a bench near the entrance, with only two awards.
Seated version: stay on one bench, give Best Seat and Best Sniff only, and let your dog explore the leash length.
Farther afield: drive to a park further away, with a car harness or crate and no time alone in the car.
Quiet version: go early on a weekday or in the off-season when fewer dogs are around.
completion: You have explored the park at your dog's pace, handed out your four awards and drawn the stamp.
photoIdea: Your dog at the Best Seat or Best Sniff spot, with the park behind them.
memoryPrompt: Which award did your dog win, and would you come back?
optionalSupplies: Car harness or crate for a farther park
substitutes: Any scrap of paper or a notes app

reservation.note: Nothing to book, but check the park's dog rules, leash laws and any closed or off-leash areas before you go.

safety: Check the park's dog rules and keep your dog on leash unless an off-leash area is posted and secure.
Keep your dog away from pond edges, algae, goose droppings and dropped food.
Bring water, rest in shade and head home if it is hot, crowded or your dog seems tired.
